cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Make It Their Idea
cards.instruction: Make an unwanted task sound appealing enough that someone volunteers for it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've put all the black chess pieces on one tray, so I've done the same. You'd enjoy sorting the club cupboard—pick the best set for yourself.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm cleaning one color at a time. A set needs both.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Cleaning first. Once the sets are ready, you could choose whichever you like.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're identical. I'd do it if you'd finally play me next week.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally, choose the opponent, not the set. Sort the cupboard and you've got me next week. I'll play whichever color you leave me.

reason: Replace arbitrary biscuit confusion with a copied sorting mistake; the reward now concerns A's own game commitment rather than unestablished authority over club pairings.
